title: What’s Your Euphoria Aesthetic Personality?
description: Answer 12 questions to discover your Euphoria aesthetic personality!

questions.text: At a late-night house party, you find yourself drawn to...

options.text: Sitting in a dim corner, watching the chaos unfold and wondering what each guest is hiding
Moving between groups, asking strangers about their wildest recent experiences
Fixing the broken speaker or restocking the snack table without being asked
Sticking to your two closest friends, swapping quiet stories about your week

questions.text: When you’re overwhelmed by a sudden emotion, you react by...

options.text: Letting yourself feel every wave of it, even if you end up crying in the shower later
Writing down exactly what triggered it and mapping out how to avoid similar feelings
Calling a friend to vent, focusing on how they’d relate to your pain
Jumping into a chore routine—folding laundry, scrubbing floors—to distract yourself

questions.text: If you had to describe your perfect night in, it would be...

options.text: Binging a new show while organizing your closet by color and texture
Writing poetry or sketching visions of alternate realities you wish existed
Hosting a small game night with friends, laughing until your sides hurt
Reading a book by candlelight, with no plans to check your phone for hours

questions.text: When making a big decision, you rely most on...

options.text: How the choice will make the people you care about feel
The hard facts and long-term consequences of each option
Going with whatever feels right in the moment, overthinking later
A detailed pros and cons list you’ve been refining for days

questions.text: When a friend shares a secret with you, you...

options.text: Connect it to a similar secret someone else told you, noticing patterns in people’s struggles
Listen carefully and ask specific questions about their current situation
Invite them to hang out with a group to take their mind off it
Hold their hand and stay quiet, letting them know you’re fully present

questions.text: How do you approach unexpected changes to your plans?

options.text: Panic a little, then quickly adjust to make the new scenario work for you
Celebrate the chaos, seeing it as a chance to do something spontaneous
Ask everyone involved how they feel about the change before deciding
Evaluate if the new plan is logically better than the original
Deep in a solo project, completely lost in your own thoughts and creativity
Leading a group project, bouncing ideas off others to build something bigger
Tackling a task with clear steps, checking off each one as you go
Daydreaming about a hypothetical scenario, imagining all the possibilities

questions.text: When you disagree with someone, you...

options.text: Focus on finding common ground, even if it means compromising your own views a little
Present your argument with clear evidence, determined to prove your point
Go with their idea to avoid conflict, planning to revisit it later if needed
Suggest a totally new option that neither of you thought of before

questions.text: What catches your eye most when walking through a city?

options.text: The way light hits old brick walls, creating shadow patterns on the sidewalk
A street vendor selling your favorite snack, and the line of people waiting for it
A group of strangers playing music, and you can’t help but stop to join in
A quiet alleyway with no one around, wondering what stories it holds

questions.text: How do you process a new song you love?

options.text: Listen to it on repeat, memorizing every lyric and drum beat
Write down how it makes you feel, connecting it to moments in your life
Analyze the chord progressions and production choices to understand why it works
Make a playlist around it, mixing in random tracks that match its vibe

questions.text: When you have a goal, you...

options.text: Tell all your friends about it, asking for their support and feedback
Keep it to yourself, working on it quietly until you’re ready to show others
Break it into tiny, actionable steps and follow them exactly
Let the goal evolve as you go, changing direction when something interesting comes up

questions.text: What’s your favorite way to unwind after a hard day?

options.text: Call up a friend and have a long, rambling conversation about nothing and everything
Do a guided meditation, focusing on your breath to clear your mind
Watch a documentary about a topic you’ve always been curious about
Cook your favorite comfort food, savoring each bite slowly

results.title: Chaotic Idealist (ENFP)
results.description: You’re the friend who drags everyone into spontaneous adventures, from late-night beach trips to impromptu poetry slams. Like Jules, you see beauty in every broken thing, and you’re constantly chasing moments that make you feel alive. You wear your heart on your sleeve, even when it gets you hurt, and you believe everyone deserves a second chance to be seen. Your Euphoria aesthetic is raw, unfiltered, and full of quiet hope.

results.title: Strategic Visionary (ENTJ)
results.description: You’re the one who always has a plan—even when things fall apart. Like Nate, you’re driven by a need to control your narrative, though your motives are rooted in a desire to protect what matters most. You see the world as a chessboard, and you’re always three moves ahead. You don’t waste time on small talk, and you expect others to keep up with your intensity. Your Euphoria aesthetic is sharp, calculated, and unapologetically bold.

results.title: Witty Provocateur (ENTP)
results.description: You’re the class clown with a hidden depth—always cracking jokes to mask the fact that you’re analyzing everyone around you. Like Kat, you use humor as a shield, but underneath it all, you’re fiercely curious about what makes people tick. You love debating just for the fun of it, and you’re never afraid to challenge the status quo. Your Euphoria aesthetic is playful, subversive, and full of unexpected twists.

results.title: Nurturing Advocate (ENFJ)
results.description: You’re the group’s emotional anchor—always the first to notice when someone’s hurting, even when they try to hide it. Like Lexi, you have a gift for seeing the best in people, and you dedicate yourself to lifting up those who feel unseen. You’re a natural storyteller, using your words to connect others and heal old wounds. Your Euphoria aesthetic is warm, empathetic, and rooted in quiet strength.

results.title: Spontaneous Performer (ESFP)
results.description: You live for the spotlight, whether you’re dancing on a table at a party or telling a wild story to a crowd. Like Maddy, you have a magnetic energy that draws people to you, and you know how to make every moment feel like a performance. You’re present in every second, savoring the highs and brushing off the lows with a laugh. Your Euphoria aesthetic is bright, bold, and impossible to ignore.

results.title: Practical Protector (ESFJ)
results.description: You’re the friend who always has a first-aid kit in their bag, remembers everyone’s birthday, and makes sure no one is left out. Like Cassie, you’re deeply loyal to the people you love, even when they don’t deserve it. You find joy in taking care of others, and you’re always looking for small ways to make someone’s day better. Your Euphoria aesthetic is cozy, reliable, and full of heartfelt gestures.

results.title: Assertive Realist (ESTJ)
results.description: You’re the one who keeps the group grounded, always pointing out the practical side of things when everyone else is getting carried away. Like Cal, you value tradition and stability, though you’re not afraid to break rules when it serves your purpose. You’re straightforward and honest, even when it’s uncomfortable, and you expect others to be the same. Your Euphoria aesthetic is solid, uncompromising, and rooted in reality.

results.title: Daring Risk-Taker (ESTP)
results.description: You thrive on adrenaline—whether you’re trying a new drug, sneaking into a closed venue, or starting a fight just for the thrill of it. Like Fezco, you’re impulsive and unpredictable, but you have a code of honor that you never break. You live in the moment, and you don’t waste time worrying about the future. Your Euphoria aesthetic is gritty, rebellious, and full of raw courage.

results.title: Quiet Dreamer (INFP)
results.description: You spend most of your time in your own head, daydreaming about a world that’s kinder and more beautiful than the one around you. Like Rue, you’re deeply sensitive and introspective, struggling to connect with a world that feels too loud and chaotic. You have a rich inner life filled with poetry, music, and secret hopes. Your Euphoria aesthetic is soft, introspective, and full of hidden depth.

results.title: Intense Strategist (INTJ)
results.description: You’re the mysterious one who always seems to know more than they’re letting on. Like Nate’s hidden side, you’re a master of manipulation, using your intelligence to get what you want. You’re fiercely independent and self-reliant, and you don’t trust easily. You see the world as a puzzle, and you’re determined to solve it on your own terms. Your Euphoria aesthetic is dark, calculating, and full of quiet power.

results.title: Curious Analyst (INTP)
results.description: You’re the group’s resident genius, always asking “why” and digging into the science behind everything. Like Kat’s online persona, you use your intelligence to create a world where you feel in control. You’re obsessed with understanding how things work, from human behavior to the physics of a perfect high. Your Euphoria aesthetic is quirky, analytical, and full of unexpected insights.

results.title: Empathetic Listener (INFJ)
results.description: You’re the friend everyone comes to with their deepest secrets, because you have a way of making people feel completely understood. Like Lexi’s quiet observations, you see the world through a lens of empathy, and you can sense when someone is lying or hurting. You’re a deep thinker, always pondering the meaning of life and your place in it. Your Euphoria aesthetic is calm, intuitive, and full of quiet wisdom.

results.title: Gentle Creator (ISFP)
results.description: You express yourself through art—whether it’s painting, dancing, or styling your friends’ outfits. Like Jules’ love for drawing, you use creativity to process your emotions and make sense of the world. You’re quiet and reserved, but you light up when you’re doing something you love. You value authenticity above all else, and you hate anything that feels fake or forced. Your Euphoria aesthetic is soft, creative, and full of personal meaning.

results.title: Steadfast Caregiver (ISFJ)
results.description: You’re the one who shows up when no one else does—staying up all night with a friend who’s heartbroken, or bringing soup to someone who’s sick. Like Cassie’s need to take care of others, you find purpose in being there for the people you love. You’re reliable and loyal, and you never ask for anything in return. Your Euphoria aesthetic is warm, nurturing, and full of quiet generosity.

results.title: Reliable Traditionalist (ISTJ)
results.description: You believe in doing things the “right way”—following rules, honoring traditions, and keeping your promises. Like Cal’s desire for a “perfect” family, you value stability and order, even when it means suppressing your own desires. You’re hardworking and responsible, and you expect others to be the same. Your Euphoria aesthetic is solid, dependable, and rooted in tradition.

results.title: Calm Problem-Solver (ISTP)
results.description: You’re the one who stays cool under pressure—fixing a broken car, disarming a tense situation, or helping a friend out of a bind without breaking a sweat. Like Fezco’s ability to handle crises, you’re practical and resourceful, always finding a way to get things done. You’re quiet and reserved, but you’re always ready to jump in when needed. Your Euphoria aesthetic is calm, collected, and full of hidden skill.
